title: Warmly Spiced Mexican Hominy Pozole
description: A garlicky and crumbly Mexican dish featuring ground coriander, this Jalisco-style pozole is a midnight craving satisfier, en-croute and gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the hominy and drain well.
In a large pot, cook the ground pork over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Mince the garlic and add it to the pot, cooking for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground coriander, cumin, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hominy, chicken broth, and browned pork to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Dice the jalapeno pepper and add it to the pot, simmering for an additional 10 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and salt.
Serve the pozole hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
